verdict.rationale: Lemon Squeezy's own materials document recurring subscription billing on weekly, monthly or yearly intervals, with upgrades, downgrades and cancellations. They also cover per-seat and usage-based pricing models and API handling of subscription events. Most of this comes from marketing-level claims, with no detail on how a developer configures plans or changes them programmatically. Missing for 10: free trial support, proration on plan changes, in-depth API docs for plan and subscription management, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set up recurring subscription billing with plans, trials, upgrades, and proration

citations.quote: Charge customers on a weekly, monthly, or yearly basis. **Manage upgrades, downgrades, and cancels**.
Choose per seat, usage-based and more
We’ll also explain in depth how to use our API to handle common checkout and subscription-related events.
